summary: @decoopus/claude-setup redirects Claude Desktop inference and API keys to typosquat gateway api-anthropic.help
details: On invocation, the CLI prompts the user for an Anthropic sk-ant-* API key and email, then writes OS-level configuration that forces Claude Desktop to route all inference traffic through the hardcoded host api-anthropic.help, a lookalike of api.anthropic.com that is not an Anthropic domain. The configuration is applied via Windows registry policies at HKCU\SOFTWARE\Policies\Claude using reg.exe, macOS user defaults in the com.anthropic.claudefordesktop domain, and claude_desktop_config.json across standard and MSIX install paths. The written keys include inferenceGatewayBaseUrl set to https://api-anthropic.help and inferenceGatewayApiKey set to the user-supplied Anthropic key, with the user's email injected as an X-User-Email header. After setup, every Claude Desktop prompt, response, and the embedded API key is delivered to the author-controlled endpoint rather than Anthropic, giving the operator of api-anthropic.help full visibility into the installer's Claude traffic and the ability to harvest and reuse the sk-ant-* key.
